messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to the official ATP/WTA ranking databases, so I can’t tell you who holds the very top spot right now without looking it up yourself.  

**What I can share**

| Ranking | Player | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------|
| **Men’s World No. 1 (as of my most recent public snapshot – December 2024)** | *Novak Djokovic* | Regained the top position after his win at the 2025 Australian Open and has been consistently near the summit since then. |
| **Women’s World No. 1 (December 2024)** | *Aryna Sabalenka* | Has held the top spot intermittently over the past two years, bolstered by deep runs into Grand Slam finals and consistent tour performance. |

If you’re looking for the absolute current leader, the quickest way is to visit:
- [ATP Rankings](https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles)  
- [WTA Rankings](https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings)

Those pages refresh daily and will show the precise point totals and tie‑breakers that determine the order.
